blocks.html:
Acura Full Car Wrap for Colour Change

What do you think of this Vinyl car wrap? Matte Orange may not be your first colour of choice when deciding on a full wrap. However, this customer decided it was exactly what they wanted for a colour change. We here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, don’t judge peoples vision, we just make it happen.

Do you want to vinyl car wrap your personal vehicle, as this customer did? Maybe add a few decals of your favourite slogan or quote?

The customer felt this vehicle used to be nothing special, factory standard, white Acura TLX. Our experienced crew used Quality 3M Vinyl Wrap to transform this car into the customer’s dream vehicle. Now it is noticeable and memorable to everyone who sees it driving down the road. We had to remind the owner to now keep it within the speed limit or the O.P.P. will also remember this car!
It does not matter which vehicle or colour it is currently; we can wrap the whole vehicle or do a partial wrap to help your stand out from the other car enthusiast. Speak to our design team and get a quote today.
We have multiple colour change options and finishes to suit your needs and we can also add details like racing stripes to your car for that added effect. We do everything in-house and make sure that you are satisfied when you leave with your car.

Colour changes or full vehicle wraps are the quickest way to revive your pride and joy.

Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/vinylwraptoronto

Instagram Page: https://www.instagram.com/vinylwraptoronto

No design is too much for us to handle, get the design that you always wanted on your personal recreational vehicle. Or wrap anything else?
Check out our equipment vinyl wraps page where we used 3M and Avery Dennison Vinyl products for more great ideas!
Give us a call today at 416-746-1381 or visit our website: https://www.vinylwraptoronto.com
